Pane OS apps (.paneapp) and the app guard
 Double-click a .paneapp file to install it with App Installer. Pane OS apps
 get full access, and the app guard protects people from them: it snapshots
 files before each run, stops an app that destroys many files and puts them
 back, puts back system files an app changed when it closes, and can undo
 everything an app changed. Includes pane-app (run, install, pack) and a
 developer guide with a sample app.

 apps install (help: links, F1) and man pages. Replaces Help (yelp) and the
 Ubuntu Desktop Guide.
